name: human-intervention
description: Solver-side half of the solve-captcha hand-off. Channel-AGNOSTIC: it publishes the canonical `solve-captcha` event (bounded payload + correlation id) onto the omniagent published-event bus, waits (bounded) for the human-intervention outcome and exposes a generic, structural page-state probe (CDP) used to detect that the challenge is gone and resume. It contains ZERO delivery code: no messaging integration, no HTTP send call, no credential, no recipient id. Delivery is a LISTENER's job (e.g. tools/echo-notify, or any other notifier plugin).

config_schema.label: omniagent API base URL
config_schema.description: Base URL of the omniagent HTTP API that hosts the published-event bus (/events/publish, /events/wait, /events/{correlation_id}).

config_schema.label: state directory
config_schema.description: Directory for the guardrail state (cooldown + per-session hand-off counts) and the audit log (hand-offs.jsonl).

config_schema.label: per-session cooldown (s)
config_schema.description: At most ONE hand-off per session per cooldown window (default 600 s = 10 min). Never a message storm.

config_schema.label: hard cap per session
config_schema.description: Hard cap on total hand-offs for one session; further requests return status `capped`.

config_schema.label: default wait bound (s)
config_schema.description: Default bounded wait for the human (the interaction deadline carried in the event payload).

config_schema.label: browser CDP base URL
config_schema.description: Chrome DevTools Protocol base URL of the browser the agent drives (used ONLY by the generic page-state probe).
